results.content:
The New York Federal Reserve’s latest Survey of Consumer Expectations showed households continued to expect inflation at 3.6% a year from now and 3% over the next five years. Expectations for inflation three years ahead edged down to 3.2% from 3.3% in July, according to the survey. [...] Inflation expectations offered little relief. Consumers continued to see inflation running well above the Federal Reserve’s 2% target and expected gasoline prices to be higher a year from now.  
  
The survey comes a week before the Fed’s September 15-16 policy meeting, putting the consumer outlook in focus as policymakers weigh whether inflation remains persistent enough to warrant tighter monetary policy.
